content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD sample wave initial/boundary condition subroutines (header comment L3 says 'FILE sample.F' though the file is samples.F). SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY (L56-83, input keyword 'SOL' per comment L50): on the physical west boundary (PARALLEL guard L63) imposes a solitary wave time series at column Ibeg with celerity c1=sqrt(GRAV*h00*(1+aa/h00)) (L68), decay tex=sqrt(0.75*aa/h00**3) (L70), free surface zz=aa/COSH(tex*(Lag_soli-c1*TIME))**2 (L72) setting Eta and H=Eta+Depth (L73-74); commented-out U/HU with note 'can not provide u and hu at boundary for dispersive equations!' (L75-77). INITIAL_WAVE (L95-160, keyword 'INI'): hardcoded test initial conditions - a box patch (L124-131), a dam-break step (L136-141) and a Gaussian hump (commented L143-145) plus an alongshore crest (L149-158) - all currently disabled by unconditional goto 200/100/213 jumps (L123, L135, L150), so the routine as written leaves Eta from the dam-break branch only... actually goto 200 @L123 skips the box, goto 100 @L135 skips the dam break, goto 213 @L150 skips the crest: net effect is Eta untouched. INITIAL_RECTANGULAR (L172-245, keyword 'INI_REC'): rectangular hump Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr)=AMP with index bounds from Xc/Yc/WID in Cartesian (PARALLEL global-to-local via iista/jjsta L202-205, ykchoi Jan/23/2018; serial L231-234) or spherical (dphi/dtheta from Lon_West/Lat_South, L213-216, L236-239), clipped to the local block with out-of-block skip (L220-227). INITIAL_GAUSIAN (L257-334, comment L251 wrongly says keyword 'INI_REC'): Gaussian hump Eta=AMP*EXP(-r**2/1.0/WID**2) with r from cell coordinates (PARALLEL offsets L288-289/L301-302; serial L315-316/L324-325). INITIAL_DIPOLE (L346-427, keyword 'INI_DIP'): dipole Eta=AMP*uni*EXP(-r**2/1.0/WID**2+0.5) with uni=-1.414/WID*(xr-Xc) (L381-382 PARALLEL Cartesian; L395-396 spherical; L409-410/L419-420 serial). INITIAL_N_WAVE (L439-499, keyword N_WAVE): isosceles N-wave per Synolakis et al. (A15)/Tadepalli-Synolakis dimensional form (comments L459-461): a0=3*sqrt(3)*Ha/2 (L462), gamma=1.5/dep*sqrt(sqrt(3/4)*Ha/dep) (L463), Eta=a0*COSH(gamma*(x-x1))**(-2)*tanh(gamma*(x-x1)) (L492), U=sqrt(GRAV/dep)*Eta (L493), V=0; STOPs silently if dep==0 (L455-458); general (non-isosceles) form commented @L490. INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE (L511-571, keyword SOL): sets alpha=-0.39 hardcoded (L534) instead of the commented formula alpha=0.5*Beta*Beta+Beta (L531) - comment L532-533 admits 'something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39... but alpha = -0.10 seems OK'; calls SUB_SLTRY (L536) for Nwogu-equation solitary coefficients, then Eta=A1*SC**2+A2*SC**4 and U=+-A*SC**2 with SC=1/COSH(B*(x-Xwavemaker)) (L545-566), direction chosen by SolitaryPositiveDirection. SUB_SLTRY(a0,h1,alp,r1,bue,ae1,ae2,au,C_ph) (L582-634): solves the cubic x**3+p*x**2+q*x+r=0 (comment L592) with p=-(alp2+2*alp*(1+eps))/(2*alp), q=eps*alp2/alp, r=alp2/(2*alp) where alp2=alp+1/3, eps=a0/h1 (L594-600) by Newton-Raphson from x=1.2 (L604, iteration L605-614, STOP after 10 iterations L610-613, convergence |fx|<1e-5 L614); returns celerity r1=C_ph=sqrt(x)*sqrt(g*h1) (L615-618) and profile coefficients au (L627), bue (L628), ae1 (L629), ae2 (L630-631).
entities: SUBROUTINE INITIAL_WAVE @L95 (END @L160); locals XX,YY @L98, sigma,x_c,y_c,a,r @L99, ii1,ii2 @L100

SUBROUTINE INITIAL_RECTANGULAR @L173 (CARTESIAN) / @L175 (spherical) (END @L245); dummies M,N,Nghost @L184, DX,DY,Xc,Yc,WID,AMP @L186 or spherical set @L188, Eta INTENT(OUT) @L190, locals Il,Jl,Ir,Jr @L191
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE @L511 (END @L571); locals A,B,A1,A2,alpha,SC,Cph,C_ph @L528, SolitaryPositiveDirection INTENT(IN) @L529

SUBROUTINE SUB_SLTRY(a0, h1, alp, r1, bue, ae1, ae2, au, C_ph) @L582 (END @L634); INTENT(IN) a0,h1,alp @L585, INTENT(OUT) r1,bue,ae1,ae2,au,C_ph @L586, locals alp2,p,q,r,x,fx,fpx,rx,cph,eps,zr,g @L587, ite @L588

equations.ref: rectangular bounds PARALLEL Cartesian; Ir/Jl/Jr @L203-205; spherical @L213-216; serial @L231-239
N-wave amplitude, Synolakis et al. (A15) comment L459
Newton residual; fpx @L606, update x=x-fx/fpx @L607, exit |fx|<1e-5 @L614
solitary celerity out; rx=sqrt(x) @L615, cph=sqrt(g*h1) @L616, C_ph @L618

! recalculate a0 and gamma based on Synolakis etal (A15)
! something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39
!    SUB_SLTRY is subroutine to provide solitary wave solution of Nogu equations
!--------Newton-Rapsons method to solve x ( >1 )for the above equation

unresolved: INITIAL_WAVE is entirely dead code: unconditional goto 200 (L123), goto 100 (L135) and goto 213 (L150) skip the box, dam-break and alongshore-crest branches, and the Gaussian is commented out (L143-145) - the routine computes xx/yy (L104-114) and constants (L116-119) but never modifies Eta
INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE ignores its Beta argument: alpha is hardcoded to -0.39 (L534) with the developer comment (L532-533) acknowledging the inconsistency between the formula, -0.39 and -0.10

Cross-line: SUB_SLTRY argument order at call site (L536) maps Cph to r1 (celerity) and B to bue, A1/A2 to ae1/ae2, A to au - caller's Cph and C_ph both receive celerity (Cph unused afterward); zr computed @L632 but never returned or used

INITIAL_GAUSIAN header comment @L251 says keyword 'INI_REC' (copy-paste from INITIAL_RECTANGULAR); gamma_s argument of INITIAL_N_WAVE (L439, L447) and x2 (general N-wave form, commented @L490) are unused; tlag @L71 computed but unused
Loop indices I,J in INITIAL_RECTANGULAR/GAUSIAN/DIPOLE come from USE PARAM (not declared locally, IMPLICIT NONE in effect) - shared module-level indices as in other files
Serial INITIAL_RECTANGULAR (L228-243) applies Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr)=AMP without the bounds clipping the PARALLEL branch has (L220-227) - out-of-range Xc/Yc/WID would index outside Eta
N-wave dep==0 guard STOPs with the explanatory WRITE commented out (L456), as does SUB_SLTRY non-convergence (L611) - both die silently
SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY imposes only Eta/H at the single column Ibeg each step; velocity is deliberately not imposed (comment L75)
